summary: Phase 3 Wetworks CRM tested (Inventory Categories + Products, Service Categories + legacy free-form, Payments report + Excel export). Backend: 26/26 new Phase-3 tests PASS in isolation; full regression 89/90 (one ordering-dependent failure in test_default_uncategorized_present_with_migrated_products — see minor issue #1). Frontend: all critical selectors and flows PASS — Inventory sidebar is a group (Categories + Products), Services nav label shows 'Services' (no 'Pricing'), /inventory/categories renders with Uncategorized default, New Category dialog creates successfully, /inventory renders as Products with search/filters/export/new-product, /services has tab-services/tab-svc-categories with working svc-cat-form + New Service category dropdown, /reports has tab-overview + tab-payments with KPIs/table/method+receivedBy filters/export, date defaults = today (2026-05-05). Previous critical bug from iter4 (legacy {discount:float} regression) is FIXED — verified by passing test_iter2_backend.py::test_invoice_edit_recalculates.

minor.issue: Seed-inserted inventory items (4 Kuwait seed items) are inserted with legacy 'category' string but NO category_id. The startup migration _migrate_inv_to_default only runs on backend startup, so a reseed after startup leaves inventory with no category_id → GET /api/inventory-categories returns Uncategorized.product_count=0 until the backend is restarted. Fix: either call _migrate_inv_to_default() at the end of the /seed handler, OR insert seed inventory with category_id=await _ensure_default_inv_category(). This causes the one failing test in the full-suite run; in isolation the assertion passes because migration had already run. Priority: LOW (functional once migrated, visible only after reseed).
Payments report endpoint requires admin/sales — returns 403 for technicians. Spec is silent but documenting the behaviour. No action needed unless tech needs access.

action_items: Backend (minor): in POST /api/seed, either await _migrate_inv_to_default() at the end or insert seed inventory with category_id pre-populated, so Uncategorized.product_count is correct immediately after reseed without a backend restart.

DELETE /api/inventory-categories correctly blocks (400) deletion of is_default or categories with linked products, and succeeds on empty user-created categories (verified all three branches).

ServiceIn still requires legacy fields 'category' (string) and 'pricing_mode' — this is fine as the free-form category is intentionally kept for backwards-compat. New category_id accepted alongside. Frontend composes both for the payload.

GET /api/reports/payments default-to-today logic is correct; filters method/received_by/date-range all work; row shape (payment_date/job_number/invoice_number/customer_name/customer_mobile/vehicle_plate/method/amount/balance_due/received_by) matches spec.
Inventory list enrichment: when a product has no category_id but has a legacy 'category' string, category_name falls back to the legacy string — good defensive behaviour.
Payments report by_method always emits cash/knet/credit_card keys with 0 fallback — good for stable frontend KPI rendering.

rca of the issue: The only failing test in the full-suite run (test_default_uncategorized_present_with_migrated_products) is caused by a seed-vs-migration ordering mismatch: seed inserts inventory items with only legacy 'category' string (no category_id), while _migrate_inv_to_default only runs on backend startup. When pytest triggers a reseed via earlier tests (phase1/iter2), the new inventory items have no category_id, so Uncategorized.product_count becomes 0 until the backend is restarted. Reproduction: POST /api/seed?reseed=true → GET /api/inventory-categories → product_count=0. Mitigation: inside POST /api/seed, call `await _migrate_inv_to_default()` after inserting inventory, OR insert seed inventory with `category_id=await _ensure_default_inv_category()` directly.
